name: Engagement of Substance Use Disorder Treatment (IET engagement, 34 days after initiation)
aliases: engagement of substance use disorder treatment
engagement of alcohol or drug treatment
certification: Approximation of HEDIS IET (Initiation and Engagement of Substance Use Disorder Treatment), not certified: built from NCQA's public measure summary; the licensed HEDIS value sets are not used (codes here are public ICD-10-CM/CPT/HCPCS examples). Index diagnoses are any visit- or claim-coded diagnosis on the event dates, not only the principal diagnosis.

citations.title: NCQA HEDIS measure summary: Initiation of Substance Use Disorder Treatment
Medicaid & CHIP Adult and Child Core Set measures (FUH, FUM, IET technical specifications)

index.label: New substance use disorder episodes (visit- or claim-coded SUD diagnosis, none in the prior 194 days)

denominator.summary: Members 13+ with a new SUD episode (first visit- or claim-coded alcohol, opioid or other drug use disorder diagnosis with no SUD diagnosis in the prior 194 days) from period start to 47 days before period end (the Jan 1 - Nov 14 intake period).

exclusions.label: Hospice or palliative care (Z51.5 / hospice encounter)

numerator.summary: Initiated (an SUD-coded visit on days 1-13) and engaged: SUD-coded visits on at least 3 distinct dates within days 1-47 (initiation + two more within 34 days; approximation: service-only engagement visits are not counted).

criteria.label: Engagement: SUD-coded visits on 3+ dates within 47 days

gap_label: New SUD episode without engagement in treatment

outreach.action: SUD treatment linkage call; schedule intake or MAT visit
